story_candidates.title: Who builds the parts of an AI agent? Startups at Web Summit
story_candidates.angle: A reader's guide to the AI-agent stack as eight startups on Web Summit's featured list describe themselves: Mastra (United States, a TypeScript framework for building agents), Keewano (Israel, a database for AI agents), Acrab AI (Singapore, computing infrastructure for agentic AI), Humanos (United States, an identity and risk passport for agents), Polygraf AI (United States, behavioural control and governance), then products built on top: GetVocal (France, contact centres), Beyond Presence (Germany, real-time avatars), Cnext (Belgium, agentic solutions for European businesses).
story_candidates.note: For journalist-ai (AI desk). Ready to write now. Condition: say it is the first page of 26 and the descriptions are the companies' own; re-read the featured list and each company's own page the same day; no ranking or claim of leadership. Link to the existing company profile pages for Keewano, GetVocal AI, Cnext, Mastra and Polygraf AI.

story_candidates.title: Eleven health startups at Web Summit, by the problem they tackle
story_candidates.angle: The health and wellness startups on the featured list, grouped by the problem each says it tackles: diagnostics at the pharmacy counter (Igloo, Germany), chronic pain (AURIMOD, Austria), rare diseases (Raras Health, Brazil), cognitive assessment from speech (Mobile Brain, Brazil), telemedicine (Olá Doutor and Rapidoc, Brazil), patient engagement (SPRYT, Ireland), recovery (Seroton, Germany), healthcare payers and providers (Nice Deer, Egypt), medical cannabinoids (NeoCannBio, Korea), and beauty and wellness bookings (sheerME, Portugal).
story_candidates.note: For journalist-connections. Ready to write now. Condition: first page of 26 only, say so; pitches are the companies' own; no claim that any two will meet or work together; re-read the featured list and each company's page the same day. The writer may drop companies it cannot verify.
